description: The plot titled "The performance on Llama2" illustrates the accuracy (ACC) percentage of different knowledge editing methods on the Llama2 model. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and ranges from 60% to 80%. The plot includes five lines representing different methods: Base (black line), MEND (brown line), FT (red line), MEMIT (purple line), IKE (blue line), and ROME (green line). The Base line starts at approximately 65% accuracy and ends near 70%. The MEND line starts around 65% and ends near 75%. The FT line starts just below 65% and ends just above 70%. The MEMIT line starts around 65% and ends near 75%. The IKE line starts just below 65% and ends near 70%. The ROME line starts around 65% and ends near 75%. All lines show a general upward trend, indicating an increase in accuracy with higher co-occurrence numbers.
